title: Punkins! II
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_A

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 16 Punkins on the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: QuestGiver_A

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill 16 Punkins on the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

We think there might be a connection to the Punkins that show up on the farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag, but we can't be sure. Right now they are just making an even bigger mess of things and they are wiping out the other Dungeon Runners we are sending to the farm to collect the golded veggies. We need you to take them out!

Head to the farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and wipe out the required number of these Punkins. Once you have done this return to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

I bet you are really rocking those Punkins' world, aren't you?! I wish I could be there when you smash there noggins into the ground. Are you ready to give it another shot?

Objectives:

  • Slay Punkins

Client level range: 92–100
